value.frequency_policy: Every CLOCK sample must match the declared frequency; mismatch rejects, not rescales the class.
value.image_policy: Pair-specific kernel and actor hashes belong to retained run provenance, not this shared class configuration.

value.retry_policy: No retry or historical observation reuse; retain failed/unfinished attempts.

value.frequency_policy: Every CLOCK sample must match the declared frequency; mismatch rejects, not rescales the class.
value.image_policy: Pair-specific kernel and actor hashes belong to retained run provenance, not this shared class configuration.

accounting.residual: checked wall minus execution-window minus READ_WINDOW; negative residual rejects, never clamps; kernel/IRQ/scheduler/host remainder remains unattributed
accounting.x2: completed execution-window ticks including transition edges and possible host stalls; not exclusive EL0 CPU time
accounting.x3: completed READ_WINDOW body ticks; checked delta exactly zero in this workload

value.envelope: End x0 minus start x0. Includes useful call, ordinary interval bookkeeping and partial endpoint transitions; does not isolate pure syscall or exclusive CPU time.
iteration: ON only: intermediate snapshot recorder write
same frequency/ordering/zero READ_WINDOW/checked subtraction oracle in both modes after end
same endpoint result stores outside envelope

modes.1: OFF: omit only intermediate recorder stores
modes.2: ON: volatile-store useful-query snapshot to fixed actor-private buffer before end CLOCK

value.observer_scope: Incremental intermediate recorder cost only; both modes retain endpoint CLOCK probes and common oracle/result export. OFF is not instrumentation-free.
value.publication: Existing Arena schemas and registry; separate DEV/PROD classes; record_eligible=false; no fabricated alternative implementation or PMU/physical/REL/RES claim.

report.failure: Partial schema-0 diagnostic after failed sample plus nonzero exit; never performance data
report.integer_encoding: exact unsigned 64-bit words, no floating-point truncation
report.success: Export schema 1 only after complete loop, then root exit 0 with acquired ownership release, frames restored and no live processes/domains

sampling.analysis: OFF primary nearest-rank descriptive median; retain raw pairs and warmups; p95/p99 adequacy and superiority inconclusive; no exact overhead subtraction
sampling.repeat_unit: fresh guest boot, not individual correlated observation
sampling.stopping: Fixed campaign; no retry, history reuse, selective removal or success-based stopping; failed/unfinished attempts retained

value.security_scope: Read-only current-process boundary, exact-source independent review, useful-query/report/termination oracle and malformed/missing evidence rejection. No invented CLOCK authorization; no malicious-kernel or fully forged custody-chain protection.
value.useful_operation: One native CLOCK query between two CLOCK endpoint calls through the same production SDK; read-only current-process observations.

value.memory_bounds: Fixed actor arrays and existing root stack/image/frame admission; actual image sizes retained per build.
value.observer_storage: Fixed intermediate snapshot recorder; ON writes and OFF omits only that recording.
value.policy: Existing native root ELF admission and reclamation; no added production quota or deadline.
value.termination: Normal root exit, owners released, original frames restored, no live processes or domains.

measurement.clock: AArch64 generic architectural counter through native CLOCK; QEMU TCG

metrics.definition: Descriptive nearest-rank median of OFF endpoint architectural-counter deltas around one useful CLOCK query and common bookkeeping; oracle checks follow the end snapshot; excludes REPORT export and does not isolate pure syscall or exclusive CPU cost.
metrics.denominator: one useful CLOCK query inside a three-CLOCK envelope

methodologies.section: 1.2 and 1.3: validation, disclosure and reproducibility principles

overhead.collection_method: Same three CLOCK calls and oracle in both modes. ON adds fixed intermediate-snapshot buffer stores inside the envelope; OFF omits only those stores. Retain matched raw arrays; cost is incremental recorder overhead, not all timestamp probes; never subtract an exact correction.

sampling.stopping_rule: Three fresh pairs per profile, OFF/ON then ON/OFF then OFF/ON; four retained warmups and 24 samples per boot. Twelve total DEV/PROD boots. No retry, selective omission, historical reuse or success-dependent stop. Boots are repeat units; within-boot observations may correlate.

security.attack_potential_scope: Not evaluated; no AP level or certification asserted.
security.ava_van_scope: Not evaluated; bounded oracle/source review is not a vulnerability analysis.

methodologies.section: TOE/SPD/SFR/SAR conceptual model; no normative component mapping
Data quality and validation of measures

sar.scope: Fresh DEV/PROD actor reports with one useful query per envelope, exact report/exit/reclamation and checked partial attribution; no broad scheduler correctness inference.
External invalid-input and retained-evidence cases for omitted operation/broken oracle, loss or corruption, mandatory SFR failure and missing SAR; no production corruption.
Independent exact-source review of CLOCK, SDK, actor and oracle; no new authority, selector, kernel probe or resource-lifetime change.

sfr.claim: Actual useful CLOCK observations satisfy fixed frequency, ordering and checked-delta oracle; normal root completion and reclamation are witnessed.
Exact-source review establishes the unchanged read-only current-process boundary; malformed or incomplete observations, failed mandatory requirements and absent evidence cannot qualify for admission.

assumptions: Trusted immutable boot inputs and working declared QEMU counter/frequency.
Existing scheduler exception isolation; exact source/image identity is retained, not cryptographically attested.
spd.attacker_model: Malformed or incomplete actor reports and altered retained evidence are supplied to the host importer; malicious kernel or fully forged custody chain is outside scope.
boundaries: No kernel instrumentation or source mutation; actor runs through the existing public ABI.
No secret noninterference, physical hardware, vulnerability certification, PMU or broad reliability/fuzz claim.
policies: CLOCK is read-only current-process observation and needs no invented device or IPC authorization grant.
Failed, truncated or unverifiable runs cannot qualify as successful measurements.
threats: Invalid, omitted or unfinished useful operation falsely admitted as a successful observation.
Changed provenance or missing required evidence accepted; observation incorrectly treated as access authority.

security.toe: Existing read-only current-process CLOCK ABI, external measurement actor/oracle and retained Arena evidence admission.

workload.useful_operation: One real CLOCK query inside two CLOCK endpoint probes; identical useful operation and oracle in recorder OFF and ON. Interval is not pure syscall latency.

limitations: QEMU TCG timer ticks, not physical throughput
Execution window includes transition accounting and host stalls; not exclusive CPU
READ_WINDOW body is zero for this CLOCK-only scenario; residual is unattributed
Matched observer comparison measures incremental recorder writes, not full CLOCK measurement overhead
Four fixed warmups do not prove stabilization; 24 samples do not establish tail latency
